description:
Plan tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- plan_creative: Plan any creative deliverable — an ad, UGC reel, storyboard, cinematic shot list (Director mode), lipsync sequence, product photoshoot, conc
- execute_plan: Materialize a storyboard plan (as returned by plan_creative (goal:'storyboard')) into real assets: generate one hero image per beat and subm
- apply_prompt_enhancement: Rewrite a short video idea into a model-ready shot prompt, tuned for the target model, aspect ratio, duration and platform.
- score_virality: Score a short-form concept for virality (0-100) using a 6-axis rubric (hook, pattern-interrupt, emotion, clarity, payoff, platform-fit).
- plan_faceless_series: Plan a 'What if…' style series of 1-4 narrated faceless episodes from one premise: an arc, a cliffhanger at the end of every episode but the
- generate_series_script: PAID, two-phase.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
